state.purpose: Judge implementation choices for a language whose audience is coding agents rather than people. Sound execution, robust refactoring and checkable product effects dominate; the summed tokens of an entire victorious task, prompts through validation, are a lesser quantified objective. Tasks T01-T27 dated 24 September 2026 describe intended construction only and claim no delivered production edit. With no external community, backwards compatibility for grammar, interfaces, earlier spellings, generated TypeScript organization or prior goldens carries no weight. Lowering must prefer identical native JavaScript/Bun behavior in generated TypeScript, reserving bespoke adapters for upholding Can guarantees and unchangeable data. Proof for Gates 1 through 5 has to be reproducible and linked; pilot anecdotes cannot certify a feature. Make the call from the material provided here, posing no question to the user.
state.task_graph: T01 establishes the repeatable foundation: recorded Bun/compiler versions, ephemeral build areas, canonical regression commands, precise before-and-after diagnostic fixtures, and advance registration of agent prompts for creation, refactor and repair with held-out forms, hidden assertions and model/effort levels governed by the evaluation protocol. Following T01, the branches T02, T03, T06, T07, T18 and T19 can run side by side. T03 is the prerequisite for T04, T05 and T08; T05 plus T06 gate T10; T03, T05, T06 and T07 gate T21. T10 gates T11, T12 and T13; T21 gates T22. T09 consolidates T02-T08 throughout compiler internals, runtime metadata, the package graph, formatting, command-line diagnostics, published docs and examples, performs exhaustive regression and intersectional failure tests (owner values at generic/package seams, variant leaves at import seams, fixture linkage after renames, error reporting after lineage edits), regenerates derived files exactly once from the consolidated tree, and satisfies Gate 1/2 solely with reproducible outcomes; T16 waits on T09, while invoice and browser work follows its listed dependencies. T10 specifies source-level action declarations and checked catalogue entries beginning from the exact-path contract, elevating the approved captured paths to the official invoice endpoints without a fallback path. T14 constructs the protected invoice readers and writers with their three narrow handlers on an actual disposable store. T17 grades the entire server matrix for Gate 3; T19 standardizes on official Bun 1.4.2 Linux x64 under Debian 13 amd64/glibc; T20 validates Gate 4 server SaaS on the deployed Linux artifact. T21 provides canlc build --target browser as a separate main-thread entry and profile carrying a transitive capability envelope and a compiler-generated content-addressed same-origin artifact. T26 revises manuals and executes held-out agent evaluations; T27 audits release readiness. Do not naively combine compiler or catalogue edits from two authors; converge on one frozen revision and re-execute touched checks.
state.evidence_limits: Evidence stops at small ephemeral spikes. An eleven-root validation study passed while foreign code minted empty email and zero quantity via constructors, with expressions, generic JSON projection, assertion parameters and supplied results. A thirteen-trial nesting study passed while a terminal decliend and a deep paidd silently captured, and the same paid token checked membership under one expected type and captured the whole value under another. A sixteen-trial variant survey produced twelve builds, twenty-four passes and four designed checker denials, documenting direct refusal that bridge indirection or leaf sharing already circumvents. A helper reuse study held 28 of 28 checks with callers holding disjoint single failures. A twelve-trial keyed-row study established that aligned same-length arrays silently cross-associate fields when rows drop controls. Eighty-two capture assertions pin native Bun behavior with strict single-segment decoding, canonical integer spelling and guarded callbacks reentering the service lifecycle. A live HTMX observation caught a genuine 503 payload failing to displace prior 422 output. An eighteen-check invoice sketch ran with neither durable rows, wire statuses nor rendered nodes. No production invoice mutation, idempotent webhook, living grid, or Linux artifact suite has cleared. No comparative agent workload with fresh held-out cases has started, so token claims would be speculation. The model distributions guide engineering thought but prove nothing here, and no call in this set runs Can artifacts or gauges calibration.
state.fixed_constraints: All compiler and catalogue revisions carry three test kinds, success paths, rejection paths and diagnostic-location precision, and rebuild emitted TypeScript with golden snapshots where they apply. All hand-written TypeScript beneath runtime/ or tools/runtime/ is followed by bun run lint:fix:runtime, bun run format:runtime, bun run check:runtime and pertinent suites, condensing linter output through bun run lint:runtime --format=agent when needed. Manual alteration of generated runtime/catalogue.ts or frozen vendor sources is forbidden. Externally visible behavior must be confirmed on true HTTP exchanges, live browser state and durable database content, never solely via an in-language assertion or advisory scores. Reports of qualification state the precise model and build, compiler revision, execution environment and each failure seen. The deferred set is not buildable work: DI-03 authored finite error sets, DI-08 capture-binding sugar, DI-14a mutation RETURNING, DI-17 novel AI wrapper/batch/callable intrinsics, DI-18 static escape or consumed-fault machinery, DI-19 arbitrary SDK inclusion, DI-20 bulk immutable tables, DI-22 named-field initializers and DI-23 multiline continuations. No worker invents those mechanisms to force a suite green.

integration_strategy.instructions: Choose how to consolidate the core semantic edits before Gate 1/2, weighing single-source consistency against continued lane velocity. Decide from contract reliability, not prose length.

criteria.single_locked_integration: Converge all core edits from T02 through T08 onto one frozen baseline covering compilation, runtime records, package resolution, pretty-printing, diagnostic rendering, documentation and illustrations. Verify with exhaustive suites and seam-spanning counterexamples spanning owner/generic/package crossings, variant/import crossings, fixture/alias crossings and error/lineage crossings. Emit generated files a single time from the converged baseline and log intentional incompatibilities. Award Gate 1/2 only for repeatable green runs; sequence T16 after T09 and permit invoice and browser efforts under their listed dependencies.
criteria.per_lane_incremental: Allow T02-T08 authors to ship separate integrations with per-task derived files, reconciling branches ad hoc and delaying intersectional checks until later server or client suites demand them.
criteria.block_all_on_core: Suspend each downstream lane entirely while core unification completes, blocking invoice, browser, webhook and shutdown activity until Gate 1/2 is fully earned, with no overlap allowed.

replay_ledger.instructions: Decide how the protected write should scope, persist and replay grid attempts while keeping denial behavior and adapter results explicit. Weigh duplicate suppression against retry simplicity.

criteria.same_transaction_ledger: Write the idempotency tuple of actor plus invoice plus operation token plus payload digest plus prior answer inside the identical transaction that applies the protected invoice edit. An exact identifier-and-bytes repeat fetches the earlier committed answer and performs no further mutation; an identifier repeat with divergent bytes becomes a conflict outcome. Nonexistent and other-tenant targets collapse to a single unrevealing 403 post-login; defective captures are refused 400 prior to authorization checks. Publish five HTML store endings, five JSON store endings and three JSON fetch endings in checked types, applying the 8192-byte JSON POST bound and the 2048-byte/64-row HTML form bounds. Following an unclear commit the HTML flow reloads state before another store, while the grid retains its labeled try for either a verbatim redelivery under the same token or an approved reread. Finite storage keeps the recovery route; post-commit presentation faults may emit 500 without guaranteeing rollback.
criteria.separate_ledger_transaction: Split mutation and bookkeeping into successive commits, landing the invoice change before its operation log, and repair the interim blind interval with a sweeper rather than atomicity.
criteria.client_new_id_retry: Resolve ambiguity by issuing a replacement operation token on every resend, so the service interprets each delivery as a new invoice change and can commit the same intent multiple times.

browser_closure.instructions: Decide how strictly the browser target must separate from server modules and unvetted scripts, weighing auditability and capability safety against authoring convenience.

criteria.strict_transitive_closure: Treat the browser artifact as an independent main-thread build whose whole callable, generic and reference closure passes a browser-capability gate. Deny transitively any path to SQL pools, process control, file access, environment secrets or privileged server ciphers, and scan generated modules and mappings for forbidden references or secret bytes. Keep pure shared dependencies and byte-exact wire logic common to Bun and each supported browser, covering big integers, bounded floats, closed variants, optional values, surplus or repeated members and owner-record translation. Model UI through opaque application, view, node and versioned-state tokens with main-thread DOM creation, text-only updates, checked attributes, focus control, immutable event copies, scoped handler/timer release and atomic snapshot replacement. Publish exclusively a compiler-derived content-addressed same-origin script under a tight content policy; exclude custom JavaScript bundles and worker execution. Interpret Fetch interruption as a local halt that says nothing about committed server work.
criteria.runtime_guarded_shared: Merge server and browser outputs into a common bundle with permissive static admission, depending on execution-time guards to intercept disallowed capability calls rather than compile-time closure.
criteria.permissive_bundling: Permit custom script authorship, third-party inclusions and worker-based execution within the browser build, removing the compiler-only content-hashed same-origin artifact rule and the emitted-graph security inspection.
